items.title: 4人のほうが難しい。協力型SFサバイバルホラーFPS「CODE EXIT」は，前半の恐怖感と，後半の無双感が楽しい［G-STAR 2026］
items.summary: 「G-STAR2026」で協力型SFサバイバルホラーFPS「CODEEXIT」をプレイした。逃げるしかない前半と，銃で敵をなぎ倒す後半の緩急が気持ちいい作品だ。ソロより4人のほうが難しい理由などを開発者に聞いた。

zh.title: 四个人的话就更困难了。合作式SF生存恐怖FPS《CODE EXIT》前半部有恐惧感，后半部有无敌感，好玩[G-STAR 2026]
zh.summary: 我在“G-STAR2026”上玩了合作的SF生存恐怖第一人称射击游戏“CODEEXIT”。前半段你别无选择只能逃跑，后半段你用枪砍倒敌人，节奏既慢又快，让这部作品的感觉很好。我们询问开发者为什么四个人一起玩比单人玩更困难。

en.title: It's more difficult with four people. Cooperative SF survival horror FPS “CODE EXIT” is fun with a sense of fear in the first half and a sense of invincibility in the second half [G-STAR 2026]
en.summary: I played the cooperative SF survival horror FPS "CODEEXIT" at "G-STAR2026". The first half, where you have no choice but to run away, and the second half, where you mow down the enemies with a gun, are both slow and fast, making this work feel good. We asked the developer why playing with four people is more difficult than playing solo.

While waiting for the bus, I met several retired professional League of Legends players. After many years, our identities have changed, but in the end we came to New York together because of "League of Legends". I greeted Umbrella King and Smeb, and they smiled politely at me and gave me a fist bump. I sat on the right side of the bus and looked at all kinds of strange buildings in New York through the window. Suddenly, the graffitied building disappeared from my sight, and I saw the Statue of Liberty in the distance. Before coming to New York this time, I made a list of places I wanted to visit in New York: Central Park, Times Square, Brooklyn Bridge, and the Statue of Liberty.

ja.summary: この時期、ほぼ全員が「GTA 6」のことを話しています。 『GTA 6』については否定的なレビューが多く見られますが、『GTA 6』の影響がゲームの分野をある程度超えて「文化現象」の範疇に入っているため、ゲーム自体とはあまり関係のない否定的なレビューも多く見られます。米国では、オンライン上のほぼ全員がこのゲームを知っており、客観的に見て、このゲームは最近のトラフィックの宝庫となっています。 X は、「GTA6」の発売以来、ほぼ最も否定的なレビューが多かったプラットフォームです。しかし、誰もが知っているように、X について意見を持つのに実際にゲームをプレイする必要はありません。 「GTA 6」が発売されたその日、私はトレンドタグ「GTA 6」をクリックしました。最もトラフィックが多かった投稿は、ゲームそのものではなく、有名なアンカーであるアスモンゴールドについての議論でした。このアンカーは、『GTA 6』の生放送中に主人公のジェイソンがガールフレンドに花や服を買っているのを見て、彼を「クソ」と思ったと言われている。

en.title: What are the negative reviews of "GTA6" on various platforms talking about?
en.summary: During this period of time, almost everyone is talking about "GTA 6". You can see many negative reviews about "GTA 6" - many negative reviews have little to do with the game itself, because the influence of "GTA 6" has to some extent transcended the game field and entered the category of "cultural phenomenon". In the United States, almost everyone online knows this game, which objectively makes it a treasure trove of recent traffic. X is almost the platform with the most negative reviews since the launch of "GTA6". But as we all know, having an opinion on X doesn't require actually playing the game. On the day "GTA 6" was released, I clicked on the trending tag "GTA 6". The post with the most traffic was a discussion of the well-known anchor Asmongold, not the game itself. It is said that this anchor saw the protagonist Jason buying flowers and clothes for his girlfriend during the live broadcast of "GTA 6" and thought he was a "cuck"
